title: clicking Save page and  view source context menu items have no result
line: In the Web Browser widget, "Save page" now saves the page to Downloads and "View page source" shows the source in the widget.
explanation: The widget's WebEngineProfile had no download handler, so the download that "Save page" starts was never accepted and silently dropped. "View page source" asks for a new window with a view-source: URL, and the widget passed every user-initiated new-window URL to Qt.openUrlExternally, so the system asked which app should open it. The profile now accepts downloads into the Downloads folder and shows a "Saved" button that opens the folder, and view-source: URLs are loaded in the widget itself.

commits.message:
applets/webbrowser: make Save page and View page source work

Nothing accepted downloads, so "Save page" did nothing, and the source
view URL was handed to the system, where no app can open it. Save pages
to the Downloads folder and show the source inside the widget instead.

BUG: 482273

media.caption: Save page in the context menu: clicking it does nothing, no file is written
After Save page: the page is saved to ~/Downloads (index.mhtml) and a Saved button appears
View page source: the system asks which app should open view-source:…
View page source: the source is shown in the widget

reviews.text: Addressing both Save page and View page source in the Web Browser applet is the right direction, but unconditionally calling download.accept() in onDownloadRequested introduces a drive-by download security issue by silently saving any webpage-initiated download to ~/Downloads without user confirmation. Additionally, loading view-source: directly into webview.url leaves Back disabled and overwrites Plasmoid.configuration.url (trapping users if the navigation bar is hidden, since Reload reloads the source view), and the download callback has object-capture, URL-encoding, and non-visible tooltip issues.
changes: Do not unconditionally accept all downloads in onDownloadRequested; either restrict automatic acceptance to download.isSavePageDownload or prompt the user with a save FileDialog so webpages cannot trigger silent drive-by downloads.

Gate view-source: handling on request.userInitiated and open it in a separate window via request.openIn(...) (or otherwise preserve Back navigation and avoid overwriting Plasmoid.configuration.url with view-source:...).

In onDownloadFinished, capture download.downloadDirectory as a local string instead of closing over the download object, encode the path properly instead of raw "file://" + download.downloadDirectory (which breaks on '#', '?', or '%'), and bind infoButton's ToolTip visible property to infoButton.hovered so users can actually see where the file was saved.

reviews.text: Both halves of the bug are addressed at the real cause in the applet: the per-widget WebEngineProfile had no download handler, and view-source: popups were sent to openUrlExternally. Accepting into the profile's default Downloads path with a clickable 'Saved' info button reuses the existing infoButton pattern and matches browser defaults; screenshots clearly show the Choose Application dialog before and the in-widget source view and Saved button after. Minor nits only: Back stays disabled after View page source (request.openIn(webview) might keep history), failed downloads give no feedback, and 'file://' + path is not URL-encoded (could use a proper file URL).
